files.unsupported: Can't open {name}: choose a PDF, a .yaml/.json config or a .tex file
files.discard: Discard the unsaved changes to the current config?
files.converted: This config generated entries from LaTeX. They're now regular entries you can edit; re-import from the Document tab.
files.pathPlaceholder: Type or paste a path (Windows paths work too)
files.wslHint: Tip: you can paste a Windows path like C:\Users\…

tex.title: Import from LaTeX
tex.subtitle: Highlight the parts of your paper that are marked in the TeX source
tex.fallbackComment: Comment when a block has no note (optional), e.g. {example}
tex.noteHelp: Comments come from {note} lines in your source, inside the marked block or on the line above it. LaTeX ignores them, so your PDF doesn't change:
tex.detectMacrosHint: Macros defined with a marker color, such as \rev, count as markers too.
tex.replacementsHint: Text for macros NotePDF can't expand, e.g. ones defined in a .sty file. Simple macros from the preamble are expanded automatically.
tex.replaceConfirm: Replace the {n} entries imported earlier? Entries you added yourself are kept.
tex.imported: Imported {entries} entries from {markers} marked blocks ({notes} notes).
tex.openPdfHint: Now open the compiled PDF to see where they land.

viewer.existing: This PDF has {n} annotations from an earlier NotePDF run. Saving replaces them.

selection.enterHint: Enter to add · Shift+Enter for a new line

list.add: Add an entry by typing its text
list.emptyHint: Select text in the PDF to highlight it, import your LaTeX revisions, or click + to type the text.
list.noNotes: Notes from a LaTeX import appear here, for example equations that couldn't be highlighted.

form.texColorHint: Use the color defined in the LaTeX preamble
form.occNthHint: Which matches to annotate, counting from 1.
form.matchHint_normalized: Normalized ignores case, punctuation, hyphenation and line breaks.
form.matchHint_exact: Exact: punctuation counts (curly quotes and dashes still match straight ones).
form.matchHint_fuzzy: Fuzzy accepts small differences, such as a changed word.
form.author: Author
form.subject: Subject
form.stickyNoteHint: Also adds a note icon in the margin, for viewers (like Chrome) that don't show highlight comments.
form.sequentialHint: Look after the previous entry's match first. Helps when the same text appears more than once.
form.fuzzyFallbackHint: If the text isn't found, accept a close match.
form.splitFallbackHint: If a long text isn't found, highlight the sentences that are.
form.continuationHint: What the second half of a highlight that crosses a page break says.

editor.noneHint: Select text in the PDF and choose Highlight or Comment, or pick an entry on the left to edit it.
editor.regexHint: A Python regular expression, matched against the text with whitespace collapsed.
editor.gapHint: You don't need line breaks or exact punctuation. Use {gap} or {gapN} to skip text you can't spell out, such as citation numbers.
editor.commentPlaceholder: Shown in Acrobat, Edge and Firefox when the highlight is clicked or hovered
editor.contextHint: Optional: tells apart identical text in different places.
editor.requiredHint: When off, a missing entry doesn't count as an error in scripts (--strict).
editor.textColorHint: Prefer matches printed in this color, such as revised text in blue.
editor.groupHint: Entries in one group share a comment. Source is the TeX file and line it came from.
editor.keyHint: Delete removes the selected entry. Changes are previewed on the PDF right away; Save PDF writes them.

doc.outputHint: Leave empty to save next to the original. Choose the same file to update it in place.
doc.removeExistingHint: This PDF has {n}. Other people's annotations are always kept.
doc.defaultsHint: Every highlight uses these unless it sets its own.
doc.noTex: Highlights imported from LaTeX can be refreshed here after you edit the source.

settings.title: Settings
settings.kEsc: Close dialogs and the selection toolbar
settings.noFuzzy: Fuzzy matching is off: install it with uv sync --extra fuzzy

empty.title: Highlight and comment PDFs without clicking through them
empty.subtitle: Describe what to highlight once, then apply it to the PDF in one step.
empty.pdfHint: Select text to highlight it, like in Edge or Acrobat.
empty.configHint: Continue with a .yaml config made here or with the notepdf command.
empty.texHint: Turn revision markers in your LaTeX source into highlights.
empty.step1: Open the PDF (and import your LaTeX, if you have it).
empty.step2: Select text to add highlights and comments; adjust them on the right.
empty.step3: Save the PDF. The highlights work in Acrobat, Edge, Firefox and other readers.

msg.nothing_searchable: Nothing searchable in this text (only punctuation or gaps).
msg.fuzzy_unavailable: Fuzzy matching isn't installed (uv sync --extra fuzzy).
msg.fuzzy_match: No exact match; using a close match (score {score}).
msg.partial_sentences: Only part of the text was found: {found} of {total} sentences.
msg.out_of_order: Found only before the previous entry's match (out of order).
msg.occurrence_missing: Occurrence {wanted} was requested, but there are only {found} matches.
msg.skip_float_caption: The {env} contents aren't highlighted (its caption is).
msg.skip_gap_only: A fragment with only math or references isn't highlighted.
msg.marker_empty: Marked block #{n} has no text to highlight.
msg.color_undefined: The color of “{name}” isn't defined in the preamble, so the default highlight is used.
